meta.title: TinyWorld · Tiny pets living on your Windows desktop
meta.description: A few tiny pets stroll along your taskbar, climb onto window edges, nap while you're busy and remind you to take breaks. Free for Windows 10 and 11.
meta.ogDescription: Tiny pets living right on your desktop: climbing windows, napping on the taskbar, real weather around them. Free for Windows.

hero.title: Tiny pets living right on your desktop
hero.lede: A few little pets stroll along your taskbar, climb onto window edges, sit dangling off corners and curl up together at night. You keep working, they keep living next to you: no feeding, no fuss.
hero.hint: Try it: click a pet, drag it up and let go, fling it with the mouse, double-click to see the time. Drag a window's title bar while a pet is standing on it, or close the window and see what happens.
hero.deskLabel: A tiny desktop with live pets you can click and drag

desk.petLabel: {name}: click to poke, drag to drop, double-click for the time

features.title: What do pets do all day?
features.lede: No stats, no quests. Just a few little friends living next to the windows you have open.

items.title: Climbing your windows
items.text: Pets climb up the side of a window, stroll along the top, sit dangling off a corner, then hop over to another window. Drag the window and they ride along; minimize it and they fall.

items.title: Click, drag, fling
items.text: Click and a pet hops, drag it up and let go and it drops, fling the mouse and it flies with the momentum. Drop it from too high and it gets dizzy, with stars spinning around its head.

items.title: You're busy, they nap
items.text: After three minutes without attention, the whole group heads down to the taskbar and naps side by side. Click anywhere on the screen to wake them.

items.title: Real weather around them
items.text: Pick your city: rain, snow, sun, thunder or fog shows up right around your pets. Heat haze rises when it's hot, and they breathe little clouds when it's cold.

items.title: Double-click for the time
items.text: A pet tells you the time, the day, the date, the lunar date and the weather in your city.

items.title: Gentle health reminders
items.text: Sat too long? A pet reminds you to rest your eyes, drink some water, and go to bed when it's late. Off by default, turn on what you need.

items.title: Quick questions, short answers
items.text: Right-click a pet to ask about exchange rates, gold prices, unit conversions or get help writing a wish, without opening a browser. No account needed.

items.title: Remembers special days
items.text: Lunar New Year, Mid-Autumn, Christmas... pets say a wish on the day. Add your own birthdays and anniversaries, on the solar or lunar calendar.

items.title: Up to three at once
items.text: When they meet they stop to say hi, sometimes walk together for a bit, and at bedtime they sleep side by side.

features.secret: Psst... stay up until 2 a.m. and see what flies across your screen :)))

weather.title: Sun and rain right next to your pets
weather.lede: Choose a city in Settings and the real weather appears around each pet, shaped to fit it. When the sky changes, a pet says something about it. Try it:
weather.note: Effects are only drawn around the pets: they never cover your screen or get in the way of your work.
weather.stageLabel: A pet standing in the chosen weather

pets.title: 22 pets, pick up to 3
pets.lede: Each one is drawn just for TinyWorld, with all 12 kinds of movement: walking, running, climbing, jumping, sitting on edges, sleeping... Click one to drop it onto the desktop at the top of the page.
pets.long: Hold Shift when clicking Long for a surprise :)))

tips.title: How to play with your pets

items.text: The pet hops; a sleeping pet wakes up, a climbing pet lets go
The pet tells you the time, the lunar date and the weather
It falls onto a window edge or the taskbar
It flies with the momentum and bounces off the walls
Opens a chat right next to the pet
Clicks through the pet to the app underneath
A secret :)))
The TinyWorld icon next to the clock: pause, show or hide pets, open Settings

calm.title: Light and never in the way

items.title: No interruptions
items.text: No sounds, no popups. Watch a video or play a game in full screen and the pets hide themselves, then come back when you're done.

items.title: Never steals your clicks
items.text: Your mouse passes through every empty spot. Clicking a pet doesn't take focus away from what you're typing.

items.title: Light on your PC
items.text: When the group is asleep the app practically rests. Pets only redraw when something changes.

items.title: Private
items.text: Never reads window titles or contents, never records your keystrokes. Screen time data stays on your computer.

items.title: English and Vietnamese
items.text: The app follows your Windows language, and you can switch anytime in Settings.

items.title: Updates itself
items.text: When a new version is out a pet tells you, and one click installs it.

download.title: Bring the pets home
steps: Open the file you just downloaded.
If Windows shows “Windows protected your PC”, click More info, then Run anyway. The app isn't code-signed yet so Windows doesn't recognize it; nothing is wrong.
Your pets appear in the bottom-right corner of the screen. All settings live in the TinyWorld icon in the system tray, next to the clock.
download.updates: The app tells you when a new version is out.
